⚠ Rescue browser data before continuing

First save this session’s JSON answers backup with the Save backup button below. Then save the raw browser record for recovery. Neither action clears votes or notes.

1. Save and share your complete JSON backup

This JSON file protects all five choices, notes, Lesley Highlights, extra nights and your place in the questionnaire, including older cards merged into one choice. Save a copy in Files or send it to Cameron before updating the app.

Choose Share backup to send the JSON to Cameron, or Save backup to keep a copy in Files. Confirm that the JSON is actually present after the Share Sheet or download.

Restore a saved backup

Undo restores your choices, notes, Lesley Highlights, extra nights and photo flags from immediately before the last import. Changes made afterwards would also be undone.

Before the first lounge session

For reliable return visits, open the app in Safari using one permanent HTTPS address, not a temporary Files/ChatGPT preview. Safari and a Home Screen copy may not share the same saved answers.

1. Run Start save test below, reopen the same address, then Verify after reopening. 2. Try one real answer and confirm it is still there. 3. Save a complete JSON backup before and after your TV session. These checks are separate from the photo tests.

2. Optional readable report

Send Cameron a readable list of your favourites, Lesley Highlights, maybes and notes. It includes only one entry for each merged experience.

3. Duplicate clean-up

The original card IDs and texts are kept in the master archive for old saved answers. Repeated experiences are only shown once.

If two old cards for the same place had different answers, the app will flag them for you to review rather than silently discarding either.

4. Print or start again

There is no automatic cloud sync. Keep your backup outside this device. App updates need the same HTTPS address to reuse saved answers.
